profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Tackle.io
profile.summary:
As a software engineer, I strive to consistently deliver market success, technical success, and personal success for myself, my team members, customers, and stakeholders.

I enjoy maintaining a healthy work-life balance by spending time with my wife and four boys, playing hockey, skiing, hiking, and fishing.  

I also enjoy attending professional groups such as the Denver JUG and Denver OSUG  to share technical ideas and information.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Benefits (AWS) — Leading ongoing engineering for Tackle's AWS Partner Central Benefits product: event-driven sync pipelines, domain modeling for complex funding workflows, and bidirectional Salesforce integration. Building serverless data pipelines (Lambda, DynamoDB streams, SQS/SNS, Step Functions) to keep partner benefit applications consistent across AWS and CRM systems, along with operational tooling for backfill, resync, and failure recovery.

Our active AWS partnership reflects the depth of this work. AWS leadership has described our Benefits engineering as among the most proactive in the partner ecosystem — putting APIs through rigorous end-to-end use and surfacing edge cases that regularly inform monthly business reviews and platform improvements. They've noted that while many partners have retreated to read-only funding experiences — or shipped transactional flows without adequate validation — we continue investing in full fund-request workflows, which AWS has welcomed as valued design-partner collaboration.

Co-Sell (AWS, Microsoft, GCP) — Delivered cross-cloud co-sell platform work spanning AWS Partner Central, Microsoft Partner Center, and GCP marketplace integrations. Solved distributed sync problems: keeping opportunities and referrals consistent when cloud APIs, CRMs, and internal stores disagree on timing or content. Experience across Go services, CDK/IaC, queue-based event processing, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, and Salesforce connectivity — building patterns once and extending them across cloud providers.

Iron Will Award — Recognized for relentless determination, resilience, and problem-solving prowess navigating ambiguous, high-complexity product domains with patience, skill, and grit.
positions.insights: Cursor AI, AI-Powered Development and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Craftsman/Principal Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Currently modularizing a large monolith into Microservices using Domain Driven Design and Principles of Microservices in order to create a reactive, adaptable, and fault tolerant system.
• Converted legacy UI into modern React client using Typescript, ES6, Redux, Redux-Saga, Reselect, Jest/Enzyme and Ag-Grid.  This also includes converting legacy API to a Hypermedia driven API using HAL.
• Co-architect RMS framework using technologies including Spring, Hibernate, Java, MSSQL
• Initiate changes in standard development practices to use Clean Code and the SOLID principles of object oriented design
• Initiate change in development procedures to agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, TDD, Continuous Integration, Code Reviews, User Stories and Estimations
• Organize and run a twice a week lunch time professional development workshop to better the personal development of both myself and other team members where we practice Katas, TDD Randori style, watch educational technology presentations, and discuss books.
• Architect and Team Lead for RMS Time and Attendance web based software application. Features include touch screen time clock with biometric interfaces, business rules engine for real time payroll calculations in full compliance with federal, state, corporate, and union rules, attendance point tracking, interfaces to payroll systems, reporting, real time alerting for overtime and violations, benefit accruals, and projected scheduling costs.
• Awards: 2007 Innovation, 2008,2011 Growth and Learning, 2009 Team Excellence

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
- Design and develop XSB XRover® Agent based software applications for data mining, information extraction, and knowledge representation
- Developed J2EE-based web service interfaces to access the XRover technology and incorporate the technology into other programming languages, including the .NET architecture.
- Designed, implemented and maintained the corporate website utilizing J2EE technologies, which included JSP, Servlets, EJB’s, JMS, and JDBC.
- Designed, implemented and maintained the customer support website utilizing J2EE technologies incorporating authentication, and SSL.  
- Developed and implemented an automated test plan to ensure the availability and proper functionality of the company websites and the underlying infrastructure.
- Project lead for the distribution of the company software.  Responsibilities included developing a user account system, website to access the software, facilitated the ability to automatically update software leveraging Java Web Start technology.  Developed a software usage tracking system.
